dimensional_gate.scope: Dimension/material-range gates only; not certification of actual product, A3 ductility, holes or delivered thickness

flexure.floor_scope: Algebraic lower bound of AISI2024 F2.2/F3.2/F4 at fixed eligible elastic inputs, Mp>=My and alpha_s>=0. Not the literal exact AISI strength or universal physical lower bound.

bimoment.option: AISI2024 G8.1-1/2, no inelastic Bp option

baseline_t150_L4000.load_case_kind: PP isolated reference at coefficient1, or a scaled mathematical control; not an AISI design combination
baseline_t150_L4000.support: Ideal forks, warping free, flexure simply supported, no sheeting or intermediate brace
baseline_t150_L4000.analysis_scope: Linear Vlasov; no physical threshold for small rotation is assigned. G8.2 shear, C1 applicability, serviceability and load introduction remain open.
